metadata.description: Lucitra Claude Code plugins — global engineering practice, delivery operations, and wiki-resident org skills

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Project-agnostic engineering practice and workstation operations: operating principles, scope discipline, incremental implementation, code review, security and threat modeling, performance, observability, git workflow, PR lifecycle and shipping; plus disk reclaim, hidden-service discovery, safe repo removal, failing-fleet triage, per-PR preview environments, local bring-up, AWS and DNS infrastructure, false verification signals, session handoffs, verifying a document before citing it, and cross-source work summaries and prioritized work queues.

plugins.name: vendor-ops
plugins.description: Vendor and tool operations for the systems a team coordinates in rather than builds: issue trackers and knowledge wikis. Confirming a tracker points at the right workspace before writing, restraint about whose tickets you touch, filing by the collection's own taxonomy, and the wiki write calls that report success and change nothing.

plugins.name: lucitra-skills
plugins.description: Lucitra delivery operations: deploy, cloud-build, qa, npm-publish, triage-dependabot, create-plan, retro, reset and sunset

plugins.name: venture-operations
plugins.description: Company operations that live beside the decisions they encode: a governed delivery pipeline (work shaping, repo orientation, story implementation, delivery review, release readiness), a trust and compliance chain with separation of duties (posture review, evidence investigation, remediation review, founder brief), knowledge-base operations (decision records, capture teardown, wiki ingest and lint), and design work against a named contract — interface design and theme audit for our own surfaces, website style extraction for a reference site.

plugins.name: crm-sync
plugins.description: Projection of the Lucitra company brain into Twenty CRM — schema reconciliation against registries/crm-schema.yaml, brain-to-Twenty record sync on brainSlug, and dated read-back snapshots that exclude third-party personal data by role
